book.name: Fayyum Fragment
book.title: Fayyum Gospel Fragment · M. R. James 1924
book.sourceNote: Public-domain historical English rendering in The Apocryphal New Testament (1924). Builder extracts only James’s explicitly identified certain fragment text, not his surrounding commentary.
book.identityNote: Very short third-century(?) papyrus fragment. James cautions that it may be a Gospel fragment or an abridged quotation in a homiletic/commentary context; Covenant does not overstate its genre.
book.rights: M. R. James 1924 historical English translation; public domain in the United States.

1.label: Fragment
1.text: all ye in this night shall be offended according to the scripture: I will smite the shepherd and the sheep shall be scattered. And when Peter said: Even if all, not I, the Lord ea. The cock shall twice crow and thou (said: Before the cock crow twice to-day ae shalt thrice deny me thou shalt thrice deny me.
